elites.designNote: Early readable elite: dodge out of the cone before the status roll lands.
Turns itself and nearby escorts into a priority shield pocket without boss-grade durability.
Adds two fragile escorts if ignored; killing the carrier stops reinforcement pressure.
Drops slow lane-denial mines with a visible warning rather than instant traps.
Telegraphs a thin rail line long enough for a lateral dodge.
Adds a tiny local cooldown hiccup only when the player stays close.
Heals nearby enemies by small chunks; the player can stop the sustain by focusing it.
Splits into weak escorts on death once, creating a cleanup beat rather than a second boss.
Briefly armors itself with obvious hardlight panels; no invulnerable wall.
Applies a soft pull with no damage and a short duration so lanes remain readable.
Fires a spaced burst, not a dense curtain.
Briefly reduces incoming damage while visibly shimmering, encouraging timed focus fire.
Marks lanes before dropping a sparse wall of slow shots.
Throws slow web orbs with visible node pulses.
Launches two slow readable missiles rather than tracking spam.
Creates harmless visual decoys that ask for target discipline without extra hitboxes.
A short close-range pulse; fair because it is radial, telegraphed, and avoidable.
Slow, tough turret threat with a single telegraphed fan burst.
Buffs nearby escorts briefly; counterplay is isolating or focusing the commander.
Late-game priority hunter with fast readable volleys, still far below boss durability.
Split crystal lances announce a three-shot refracted fan. Cross the narrow center before the prism opens.
Its five refracted lanes widen after lock. Hold a quiet edge, then cut behind the outer shard.
Seven bright verdict lines are still a pattern, not a wall. Wait for the center split and take the returning lane.
Three slow impact seeds fall below the hull. Move after the forecast circles settle, not during the first flash.
Its staggered comet bloom rewards one clean lateral move. Do not drift back into the delayed center shell.
The heavy bloom leaves a deliberate seam between salvos. Break the artillery before the next crown ignites.
The red vector is the dash path. Leave it once, then punish the recovery instead of racing the hull.
Twin lock brackets predict its crossing shot. Let the brackets close before spending Phase.
It dashes farther and fires faster, but the final vector is honest. Cross behind the talon and keep shooting.
Six orbiting nails launch from visible nodes. Slip through the first gap before the halo changes phase.
The eight-node ring rotates before release. Match the rotation briefly, then exit through the widest interval.
Ten knives look worse than they are when read as one rotating clock. Move against the crown, never with it.
The small clock lattice punishes close firing and dodging. Break range before the final tick.
Its cold field pulls softly while delaying controls. Use the long telegraph to leave the lattice entirely.
The magistrate owns nearby time, not the whole screen. Disengage during the clock bloom and return on cooldown.
The tether steals space and repairs nearby hulls. Cut sideways out of the cone, then remove the collector first.
Its double tether sustains the formation only while the links hold. Break range or break the vessel.
The reclaimer pulls harder near the core and converts the moment into repairs. Refuse the center and focus it down.
Gold tethers mean nearby guns are accelerating. Silence the conductor before clearing its suddenly brave choir.
The marshal links more allies and adds a measured pulse. Strip the throne from the formation, then clean up.
Its ten-note command crown turns a wave vicious without making it immortal. Delete the singer, not the symptoms.
Two phase echoes show where it is not. The bright center seam shows where the ambush will actually fire.
It opens three rifts but commits to one firing vector. Watch the locked brackets, not the decoys.
The butcher phases through the first answer and attacks on the second beat. Delay your dodge until the echo collapses.
Two diagonal ion seams cross at the old player position. A short vertical correction clears both blades.
The divider adds a delayed center shear. Cross the first diagonal, then hold instead of correcting twice.
The cleaver paints three intersections before firing. Pick the empty corner early and make the ship chase your bullets.
The beacon marks a sparse missile pair and one mine lane. Move once after the target grid stops following.
Its ordnance doors alternate missiles and lane shots. Read the door color and take the opposite route.
The final arsenal combines every forecast but leaves a wide outside lane. Take it, then punish the long reload.
